pullRequest.body:
Part of #16

## Problem

Tag `v0.1.0-rc.1` (run 39738221578) stopped at the Publish release step: „Uploaded asset platform-v0.1.0-rc.1.zip does not report the digest sha256:6a087e41…; release stays a draft.“ The uploaded asset was not a ZIP but the text of decimal byte values (`80 75 3 4 10 0 …`).

## Cause (verified)

`Invoke-ReleaseApi` assigned `$request.Body = if ($Body -is [byte[]]) { $Body } else { … }`. The output of an `if` expression is enumerated, so the `byte[]` became `object[]`. `Invoke-WebRequest` sends a non-`byte[]` body as its string form. Verified locally: `$x = if ($true) { [byte[]](80,75,3) }` gives `System.Object[]` and `"$x"` gives `80 75 3`.

The test stub cast the body back with `[byte[]] $Body`, so it hid the bug.

## Change

- `tools/Publish-PlatformRelease.ps1`: assign the body inside the `if` branches.
- `tools/tests/PlatformRelease.Tests.ps1`:
  - The upload stub hashes what `Invoke-WebRequest` would send: only a `byte[]` is binary, anything else is its string form.
  - New test: the upload body is `System.Byte[]` with the exact file content and `application/zip`.
  - New test: a rerun for a new tag ignores an existing draft of another tag. It creates its own release and does not change the foreign draft or its assets.
- No other site in the repository passes a binary body through an `if` expression (searched `tools/` and `modules/`).

API: [Upload a release asset](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud@latest/rest/releases/assets#upload-a-release-asset), `X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10` (raw binary body).

## Validation

- Before the fix, 16 tests in `PlatformRelease.Tests.ps1` failed with the production error message.
- After the fix: `Invoke-Tests.ps1 -CI` 2039 passed / 0 failed, `-Tag Interruption` 8 passed, mutation checks `release-asset-digest` (9/9), `release-published-state` (13/13) and `release-tag-commit` (6/6) were killed.
- Security checkpoint (independent review, gpt-6.1-sol): no findings.

Tag `v0.1.0-rc.2` will be created after merge.
